# BC Partners to Increase Ownership Stake in Mount Logan Capital Inc.


October 27, 2026 8:00am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_40aaf19935c0678f9b1b027ad22329dc/mountlogancapital/news/2026-10-27_BC_Partners_to_Increase_Ownership_Stake_in_Mount_129.pdf)


### Mount Logan announces that BC Partners, a long-standing shareholder and strategic partner, has adopted a Rule 10b5-1 and Rule 10b-18 trading plan to acquire additional shares of Mount Logan common stock in the open market


NEW YORK, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Mount Logan Capital Inc. (Nasdaq: MLCI) (“Mount Logan” or the “Company”) today announced that BC Partners Group Holdings Limited, together with certain of its affiliates (“BC Partners” or “BCP”), a long-standing shareholder and strategic partner of the Company, intends to increase its ownership position in Mount Logan through additional purchases of up to $1.5 million of the Company’s common stock over the next 12 months. BC Partners currently holds approximately 2% of the Company’s outstanding common stock.


BC Partners has adopted a trading plan (the "Plan") providing for open-market purchases of Mount Logan common stock. The Plan commenced on October 23, 2026 and purchases are expected to continue through September 22, 2027. The Plan was adopted in accordance with the requirements of Rule 10b5-1 and Rule 10b-18 under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, and purchases under the Plan will be conducted through an independent broker-dealer, subject to customary price and volume parameters. The Company is not a counterparty to the Plan.


“BC Partners has been a founding partner of Mount Logan since its inception. The adoption of this trading plan is a further expression of the alignment between our two organizations that has defined the platform from the outset,” said Ted Goldthorpe, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Mount Logan and Partner and Head of Credit at BC Partners. “We remain focused on executing against the strategic initiatives we have laid out – scaling our integrated asset management and insurance model, growing recurring fee-related earnings and continuing to invest in distribution. The alignment reflected in this plan reinforces the long-term value creation opportunity we see ahead for Mount Logan stockholders.”


**About Mount Logan Capital Inc.** Mount Logan Capital Inc. is an integrated alternative asset management and insurance solutions firm focused on generating durable, fee-based revenue and long-term value creation. The Company leverages differentiated investment strategies alongside permanent insurance capital to deliver attractive, risk-adjusted returns across market cycles.


Through its subsidiaries, Mount Logan Management LLC and Ability Insurance Company, Mount Logan manages and invests across private and public credit markets in North America and operates an insurance platform that provides long-duration liabilities to support its credit investment strategies. This integrated platform is designed to provide stable earnings, downside protection, and a low risk of principal impairment through the credit cycle.


As of June 30, 2026, Mount Logan Capital had over $2.0 billion in assets under management.

**About BC Partners Group Holdings Limited**
BC Partners, founded in 1986, is a leading international investment firm with deep investment heritage in private equity and private debt.
